title: NGINX ngx_http_v2_module vulnerability
desc: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypas

title: GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 SQL Injection via StaffGroup InsertSubmit
desc: GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the staff group management feature that allows authenticated attackers with administrator privileges to execute arbitrary SQL queries by supplying a crafted title parameter to /admin/index.php?/Base/StaffGroup/InsertSubmit. The Controller_StaffGroup.RunChecks() method concatenates the unsanitized title value directly into a dup

title: Fleet before 4.92.0 SQL Injection via order_key Parameter
desc: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated observer-level users to sort software listings by arbitrary columns via the order_key parameter. Attackers can order by joined hosts table columns such as node keys and use pagination as a binary-search oracle to extract sensitive column values.

title: Obot 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 Access Token Theft via OAuth Resource Metadata
desc: Obot from 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 fails to validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server protected resource metadata, allowing malicious MCP servers to steal access tokens. Attackers can name a different service and authorization server with chosen scopes, causing Obot to obtain the victim's token for that service and forward it to the attacker.

title: Incus before 7.6.0 VM Disk Hijacking via Abstract NBD Unix Sockets
desc: Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration and disk export on abstract unix sockets, which have no permission checks and whose names are visible in /proc/net/unix. A local unprivileged user can connect while an operation runs to read or modify the VM disk, gaining code execution in the guest on a migration's receiving side.

title: Incus before 7.6.0 Privilege Escalation via Rebuild of Never-Started Container
desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.

title: Incus before 7.6.0 Authentication Bypass via Unverified Client Certificate Chains
desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. title: Incus before 7.6.0 Improper Authorization Exposes Default Project Resources
desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted and view-only clients to read default project resources by requesting the default project directly. Attackers knowing resource names can read profiles, images, network zone peer keys and stored credentials, and export custom volume or bucket backups to obtain full contents or S3 admin keys.

title: Incus before 7.6.0 LXC Configuration Injection via OCI Image Config
desc: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. desc: monailabel (aka MONAI Label) before 0.8.6 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.

desc: odf-kit is a TypeScript and JavaScript library for working with OpenDocument Format files. In versions 0.9.8 through 0.14.1, the odsToHtml() renderer inserts document-controlled cell formatting and row height values into HTML style attributes without escaping them. title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 Stored XSS via Role Name in Profile View
desc: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows role administrators to inject JavaScript by placing quote-breaking payloads in role names rendered unencoded in the data-message attribute in modules/profile/roles_functions.php. Attackers can execute scripts when a full administrator views an affected profile page, stealing the CSRF token to assign themse

title: @better-auth/electron before 1.7.16 Auth Secret Disclosure and Two-Factor Bypass
desc: @better-auth/electron 1.5.0-beta.12 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 accepts any validly signed value as its transfer cookie and returns the full endpoint context, including the auth secret and social provider client secrets, in sign-in responses. title: ArcadeDB 26.2.1 before 26.11.1 Database Enumeration via MCP Tools and Bolt LOGON Flaw
desc: ArcadeDB 26.2.1 before 26.11.1 contains an observable response discrepancy in MCPToolUtils.resolveDatabase, which checks database existence before authorization and returns distinct 'not authorized' and 'does not exist' errors; separately, a failed Bolt LOGON from READY leaves the previous principal bound after RESET. Authenticated MCP callers can enumerate names of databases they are not granted

title: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 OS Command Injection via Liquidsoap Annotation Values
desc: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 fails to escape backslashes in Liquidsoap annotation values, allowing media managers to break out of quoted annotation strings. Attackers can set a crafted ID3 title ending in a backslash to inject a process: protocol URI, achieving OS command execution in the Liquidsoap container during playback.

title: Frappe 8.8.0 before 16.30.0 IDOR via SMS Settings get_contact_number API
desc: Frappe 8.8.0 before 16.30.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the SMS Settings get_contact_number API that lets attackers read any Contact's phone numbers without permission checks. Attackers can call the endpoint, which uses an uncorrelated EXISTS subquery, to retrieve mobile_no and phone values of arbitrary Contact records, exposing PII.

title: Finsys Dockhand 1.0.7 before 1.0.57 Path Traversal via Stack env/raw Endpoint
desc: Finsys Dockhand 1.0.7 before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to read and write arbitrary files by setting an unvalidated envPath on a stack source. Attackers with stacks:edit permission can point envPath to files like /etc/shadow or SSH keys, then use GET or PUT on /api/stacks/[name]/env/raw to read or overwrite them.

title: MailAssure / SpamExperts: Server-Side Request Forgery in relay LDAP synchronisation connection check
desc: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

title: AIOStreams 2.9.0 through 2.38.1 Internal Secret Disclosure via String-Prefix Origin Check
desc: AIOStreams 2.9.0 through 2.38.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in makeRequest() that leaks the internal secret header by matching URLs against INTERNAL_URL using a string-prefix check. Attackers can supply a custom addon manifest URL or redirect to a prefix-matching host or port to capture the secret and directly call internal addon routes.

title: Contiki-NG through 5.2 Out-of-Bounds Write via MPL Seed ID Length
desc: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the MPL multicast engine that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to corrupt memory via unchecked seed ID lengths. Attackers can send near-maximum-size MPL messages with an S=3 option in a short hop-by-hop header, causing data_message_expiration() to write 16 bytes past uip_buf and crash the node.

title: FontForge through 20251009 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via PCF Encodings Table
desc: FontForge through 20251009 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PcfReadEncodingsNames() that allows attackers to corrupt memory via negative glyph indices from truncated PCF encodings tables. Attackers can supply a crafted .pcf file imported through the GUI or scripting Import() command to write before the encs array, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: Convoy before 26.6.0 Cross-Organisation Information Disclosure via Dashboard Organisation Routes
desc: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated dashboard users to read other organisations' data due to missing membership checks on /ui/organisations/{orgID}/ read routes. Attackers who know another organisation's ID can request members, invites/pending, and projects endpoints to obtain member emails, roles, pending invitee emails, and project list

title: MyBibliotheca 3.0.0 before 3.0.4 IDOR via Books API Update and Delete
desc: MyBibliotheca 3.0.0 before 3.0.4 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify or delete other users' books via /api/v1/books/<book_id>. Attackers can obtain book UUIDs from recently added books across all owners, then send PUT or DELETE requests to rename, alter, or permanently delete them.

title: Daptin before 0.13.61 Incorrect Authorization via CardDAV PUT Contact Update
desc: Daptin before 0.13.61 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to overwrite restricted contacts by sending CardDAV PUT requests to existing contacts. Attackers holding address book Update permission can bypass per-contact row permissions in PutAddressObject to modify protected contacts and confirm their existence.

title: Anchr before 3.7.2 Stored XSS via Image Upload
desc: Anchr before 3.7.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to host HTML files by uploading them through the image upload feature with a spoofed image content type. Attackers can upload an .html file served via GET /api/image/:id from the Anchr origin, running script that steals the victim's localStorage session token for account takeover.

title: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 Use-After-Free via File_Vorbis::Setup
desc: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the Vorbis setup header parser that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory via crafted files. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg/Vorbis file that makes File_Vorbis::Setup() return early without BS_End_LE(), leaving a stale bitstream pointer that causes crashes or heap disclosure.

title: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 Out-of-Bounds Read via File_Mpegv::Streams_Fill
desc: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpegv::Streams_Fill() that allows attackers to read adjacent memory via an uninitialized chroma_format index. Attackers can craft media files that reach Streams_Fill() before Synched_Init(), crashing MediaInfo or embedding applications and possibly exposing static memory in parser output.

title: WPC Product Options for WooCommerce before 4.0.9 Price Manipulation
desc: WPC Product Options for WooCommerce before 4.0.9 contains a price manipulation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to purchase products at an arbitrary price by submitting crafted wpcpo-* option data with a negative price in an add-to-cart request. desc: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain another user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials by supplying that user's uid. desc: DreameHome device sharing and MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows former share recipients to keep receiving a device's MQTT status messages after the owner revokes sharing. title: Util-linux: util-linux: x-mount.subdir detached-tree resolution can escape via intermediate symlinks
desc: The X-mount.subdir option uses a detached-tree fast path on Linux 6.15 and later and passes the configured subdirectory to open_tree() with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW. That flag does not stop intermediate symlink traversal or keep resolution inside the newly mounted filesystem. A local unprivileged user with an fstab-authorized X-mount.subdir entry can attach a host path at the intended mountpoint.

desc: Improper input validation within the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver could allow an attacker with privileged access to overwrite SMRAM, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

desc: Downloading and building modules with malicious version strings can cause local code execution. title: @fastify/express vulnerable to path-scoped middleware bypass via prefix and mount path join mismatch
desc: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.9, the plugin joins a path-scoped middleware's mount path to the Fastify plugin prefix by string concatenation, so when the plugin prefix ends with a slash or the mount path omits its leading slash, the resulting Express mount path does not line up with the rou

title: EoE Fragment Reassembly Heap Out-of-Bounds Write
desc: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

title: EoE Timestamp-Strip Integer Underflow
desc: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.

title: CoE SDO Download Bounds Check Failures on Flexible-Length Objects
desc: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

title: CoE SDO Segmented Download Missing State Guard
desc: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

title: CoE SDO Segmented Download Cumulative Out-of-Bounds Write
desc: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

title: CoE OD Sentinel NULL Pointer Dereference
desc: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

title: CoE sizeOfPDO Descriptor Traversal Out-of-Bounds Read
desc: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.

title: FoE Data Length Unclamped Out-of-Bounds Read
desc: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

title: EoE Set-IP Out-of-Bounds Reads Before Bounds Check
desc: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. title: CoE SDO Download Out-of-Bounds Read via Undersized Frame
desc: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. title: FoE Filename Matching Bypass via Length Truncation
desc: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. title: CoE SDO Download NULL Pointer Dereference on Dataless Entry
desc: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.

title: FoE Unconfigured Access NULL Pointer Dereference
desc: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

title: EoE Unconfigured Access NULL Pointer Dereference
desc: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.

title: CoE PDO Mapping Size Exceeds Process Data Buffer Out-of-Bounds Write
desc: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEO

title: CoE PDO Mapping of Dataless Entry NULL Pointer Dereference
desc: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

title: CoE Complete Access Download to Dataless Entry NULL Pointer Dereference
desc: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

title: CoE Object Name Null Terminator Off-by-One Out-of-Bounds Write
desc: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. desc: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes. Attackers can supply an AVIF stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge box length, forcing the parser to buffer all received bytes and causing denial of service.

title: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 Memory Exhaustion via WebP EXIF Chunk Length
desc: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory buffering vulnerability in parseExif in lib/parse_stream/webp.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via an attacker-declared EXIF chunk length. title: Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 Out-of-Bounds Read via mg_timegm
desc: Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that allows remote attackers to crash the process via crafted X.509 certificate validity months. Attackers can present a certificate with month '00' or out-of-range values during the handshake, before signature verification, causing an unchecked dm array index and denial of service.

title: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 Denial of Service via Attachment Preview Resizing
desc: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to crash the server by uploading extreme-width images as task attachments. Attackers can request the attachment preview endpoint so Lanczos resampling allocates width-proportional weight tables, OOM-killing the process repeatedly with sub-megabyte PNGs.

title: Vikunja 0.8.0 before 2.8.0 Denial of Service via CalDAV PROPFIND Duplicate Properties
desc: Vikunja from 0.8.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated project readers to amplify response size by repeating requested properties in CalDAV PROPFIND requests. Attackers can send PROPFIND requests to the dav projects endpoint with hundreds of duplicate calendar-data properties to exhaust server memory, CPU, and bandwidth.

title: Vikunja 0.16.0 before 2.8.0 Trello API Token Exposure via Migration Logs
desc: Vikunja from 0.16.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that writes users' Trello API tokens to application logs and Sentry by formatting provider errors verbatim in listeners.go. When a Trello migration fails with a transport error, the URL error embeds the token query parameter, letting anyone with log or telemetry access obtain the reusable third-party credential.

title: Vikunja from 0.20.5 before 2.8.0 Login CSRF via OIDC Callback State Check
desc: Vikunja from 0.20.5 before 2.8.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the OpenID Connect callback in OpenIdAuth.vue that accepts a valueless state parameter. Attackers can send a crafted callback link with an empty state and their own authorization code to silently log victims into the attacker's account and view the victims' entered data.

title: Vikunja 2.2.0 before 2.8.0 Information Disclosure via tasks.overdue Webhook Payload
desc: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' private projects through the tasks.overdue webhook payload. Attackers can register a personal tasks.overdue webhook with one subscribed overdue task, then receive project titles, descriptions, and owner IDs from other users' reminders at external URLs.

title: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 Account Takeover via OIDC Email Fallback
desc: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows attackers to hijack SSO identities by planting local accounts with unverified victim emails. When emailfallback is enabled, attackers register or edit a local account using the victim's email, causing the victim's first OIDC login to link into the attacker-controlled account and expose their data.

title: OpenRemote 1.2.0 before 1.34.0 Authorization Bypass via AlarmFacade
desc: OpenRemote from 1.2.0 before 1.34.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in AlarmFacade that allows restricted users with write:rules to create alarms for assets outside their ruleset subtree. Attackers can deploy a JSON asset-scoped ruleset using target.custom asset ids to create HIGH severity alarms and trigger operator notifications about arbitrary in-realm assets.

desc: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows clients with table write access to persist writes refused by THROWing table events within interactive transactions. Attackers can run a guarded statement via RPC begin and query, ignore the returned error, and commit to persist the record and event side effects.

desc: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a guard bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute write subqueries by embedding them in LIVE query WHERE clauses or field projections. desc: SurrealKV before 1.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the safe InternalKeyRef::from_encoded constructor, which only checks key length with a debug-only assertion. title: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 Authorization Bypass via FOR Loop Variable Shadowing
desc: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to shadow protected $access, $auth, and $token variables by binding them as FOR loop variables. desc: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read schema definitions of denied types through listings ignoring per-type ACLs. title: Mailflare before 48957fb Host Header Injection in Password Reset
desc: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

title: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 Orphaned SMF Sessions via Create SM Context Response
desc: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a missing resource release vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to orphan SMF sessions by triggering Create SM Context response processing failures. Attackers can repeatedly release the RAN UE context while responses are pending, causing AMF_SESS_CLEAR() without Release SM Context requests and degrading SMF availability.

title: OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 Memory Leak via SM Policy Deletion

Attackers can trigger repeated SM policy create and delete cycles over N7 via PDU session establishment and release to grow PCF memory without bound and break association lookups.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion via xmt_parse_command
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that casts target nodes to GF_ParentNode without validation. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT-A file whose command targets a non-grouping node, causing gf_node_list_get_child() to perform an invalid memory read and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Double Free via gf_sg_sfcommand_del
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that leaves a stale GF_Command pointer in a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer when the buffer element is not properly closed. title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_sg_command_new via XMT Loader
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via MPEG-4 Sensor Handling
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that makes compositor_mpeg4_get_sensor_handler_ex() call hs->IsEnabled through a near-NULL pointer, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via xmt_text_content
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in XMT Loader
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Heap Buffer Over-read in gf_xml_sax_peek_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via Discarded XMT Nodes
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf_node_unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Uncontrolled Recursion via xmt_discard_subtree
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via Stale URL Segment Pointer
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

title: Servas before 1.2.0 Missing Authorization in Tag, Link, and Group Controllers
desc: Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via Discarded Out-of-Scope Node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

title: freedit before 0.9.9 Authorization Bypass in Post Editing via Private Inn
desc: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the edit_post_post handler for POST /post/edit/:pid that skips ownership and status checks when a Private inn is submitted. Members of a Private inn can overwrite any post by sequential id, including moderator-locked posts, re-attributing it to themselves and destroying original content.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in TraverseForm
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Uncontrolled Recursion via gf_sg_proto_instantiate
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via gf_sg_proto_del
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node_code lists is freed by gf_sg_reset(), and gf_sg_proto_del() then calls gf_node_unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via SFNode Replacement
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion in gf_sg_command_apply MFNode Field Replace
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in gf_sg_command_apply via MFNode Field Replace Without Value
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via JSScript_LoadVRML
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in Compositor Node Handlers
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_event_target_get_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in gf_sg_proto_create_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Out-of-Bounds Read in avilib via AVI Audio Tracks
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_sg_proto_del via XMT PROTO Delete
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion in ctxload_process via XMT ODUpdate
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Heap Buffer Over-read via Text fontStyle Type Confusion
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_node_unregister via PROTO Nodes
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion via Curve2D point Field
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

title: OpenShot Video Editor through 4.1.1 Deserialization via Legacy Project Import
desc: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

title: xuxueli xxl-job Group Management JobGroupController.java update cross-site request forgery
desc: A security vulnerability has been detected in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is the function insert/update of the file admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/business/controller/JobGroupController.java of the component Group Management. The manipulation of the argument addressList leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The ven

title: Open Asset Import Library Assimp ASE File Importer ASELoader.cpp InternReadFile out-of-bounds write
desc: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. P

title: itsourcecode Event Management System booking.php cross site scripting
desc: A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file booking.php. Such manipulation of the argument venue_id leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

title: Members WordPress Plugin 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 Private Site Authentication Bypass
desc: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. Attackers can request the front-end login path with a pagename query variable to make WordPress render hidden published pages or the full blog index.

title: Members WordPress Plugin before 3.3.1 Missing Authorization via Latest Comments Block
desc: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.

title: Members WordPress Plugin before 3.3.1 Missing Authorization via Latest Posts Block
desc: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

title: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 CSRF via Show Delete Action
desc: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.

title: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 Denial of Service via Bencode Decoder Recursion
desc: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.

title: anacrolix/torrent before 1.63.0 Improper Certificate Validation via HTTPS Tracker Client
desc: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.

title: libical before 4.0.7 Double Free via icalparser_clean
desc: libical before 4.0.7 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in icalparser_clean() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying truncated iCalendar input. Attackers can provide an iCalendar file or stream missing a matching END line, causing the returned component to be freed twice and crashing applications.

title: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 Use-After-Free via WinPR LinkedList Enumerator
desc: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the WinPR wLinkedList collection because LinkedList_FreeNode() frees nodes without updating the cached list->current enumerator pointer. When calling code removes the node the enumerator references, LinkedList_Enumerator_MoveNext() or LinkedList_Enumerator_Current() reads freed heap memory, which can crash the process.

title: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 XSS via Chunked Upload Race Condition
desc: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users with upload permission to bypass SVG sanitization. Attackers can race concurrent chunked uploads sharing a filename to swap a benign SVG with a script-bearing SVG, executing stored cross-site scripting in the site origin.

title: Electerm before 5.9.0 OS Command Injection via Unicode Quotes in PowerShell
desc: Electerm before 5.9.0 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code via crafted file or folder names containing Unicode quote characters. Attackers can deliver names containing U+2019 through archives, WSL distributions, or SMB shares, which break out of getFolderSizeWin() and calcLocal() quoting when victims request folder sizes, execut

title: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 Denial of Service via Parser max_tokens Comment Runs
desc: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the parser max_tokens limit using long runs of comments. Attackers can submit GraphQL documents of consecutive comments that Lexer.lookahead fully tokenizes before limit checks, consuming CPU and memory proportional to document size.

title: Donetick before 0.1.86 Path Traversal via Profile Image Field
desc: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' files by storing a crafted image value via PUT /api/v1/users. Attackers can set their image to a traversal key and upload a new profile photo, causing storage.Delete to remove other users' attachments or photos under the storage root.

title: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 Login CSRF via OIDC Callback
desc: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback handler because OIDC state is not bound to the initiating browser. Attackers can start an OIDC login with their own account and lure victims into opening the withheld callback URL, logging them into the attacker's account to read saved snippets.

title: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 Stale Email Verification Status via PATCH /email
desc: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an improper verification vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retain the emailVerified flag by changing their email address while EMAIL_VERIFICATION is disabled. Attackers with a previously verified account can set another person's address via the PATCH /email handler, receiving OIDC email_verified=true claims to impersonate that owner in relying applica

title: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 ProxyAuth Access Control Bypass via Encoded Path Separators
desc: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

title: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 Authorization Bypass via WebSocket Attach and Exec
desc: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows Standard users to access other users' containers via the WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with shared environment access can use leaked container or exec IDs to hijack sessions over /api/websocket/attach or /api/websocket/exec, gaining interactive ro

title: Opencast before 20.6 Path Traversal via Workspace File Resolution
desc: Opencast before 20.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in WorkspaceImpl.toWorkspaceFile that allows authenticated ingest users to write files outside the workspace root via unvalidated element paths. Attackers can submit media packages whose element URIs or identifiers contain ../ sequences, causing Workspace.get to create directories and write fetched content with Opencast process privilege

title: Gogs before 0.14.4 Path Equivalence Bypass via NTFS .git Aliases
desc: Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

title: diaspora* before 0.10.0 Path Traversal via Account Import Photos Archive
desc: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a path traversal (zip slip) vulnerability in ImportService#unzip_photos_file that allows authenticated users to write files outside the extraction folder. Attackers can upload a crafted photos zip archive during account import with ../ entry names to create new files at arbitrary locations writable by the diaspora* process.

title: diaspora* before 0.10.0 HTML Injection via Inviter Name in Invitation Emails
desc: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in Notifier#invite that allows authenticated users to inject HTML or markdown into invitation emails through unescaped profile names. Attackers can set profile first or last names containing raw HTML, links, or images so invitation emails sent from the pod render spoofed content in recipients' mail clients.

title: msgpackr before 2.1.4 Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity via UnpackrStream and decodeIter
desc: msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

title: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0 Decompression Bomb via permessage-deflate
desc: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0 contain a decompression bomb vulnerability because messages are fully inflated before maxLength is enforced. Unauthenticated remote clients negotiating permessage-deflate can send highly compressible messages, forcing processIncomingMessage() to allocate excessive memory and crash the s

title: mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 Argument Injection via Flag-Shaped Positional Operands
desc: mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows remote MCP clients to inject kubectl flags by supplying dash-prefixed values as positional operands in tools such as exec_in_pod, kubectl_patch, and kubectl_logs. Attackers connected over SSE or Streamable HTTP transport can supply values like --filename to make kubectl read files from the server host, bypa

title: Delta Sharing Server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 Incorrect Permission Assignment via Azure SAS Tokens
desc: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.

title: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 HTTP Request Smuggling via ASGI Python Parser
desc: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-en

title: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 Memory Exhaustion via ASGI HTTP/1 Parser
desc: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

title: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 Improper Signature Verification via HTTP-Redirect Binding
desc: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered val

title: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 Link Following via .actrc --eventpath
desc: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 contains a link following vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to read host files by setting --eventpath in an untrusted project .actrc to a symlink. Attackers can commit an event.json symlink pointing to files like ~/.ssh/id_rsa, which act copies into the job container as GITHUB_EVENT_PATH for workflow steps to exfiltrate.

title: erxes before 3.4.14 Missing Authentication via insurance_api Contract Template Mutations
desc: erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

title: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 Stored XSS via SVG Sanitizer Re-serialization
desc: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sanitize-svg function that allows authenticated users to bypass filtering through unescaped re-serialization. Attackers with file edit permission can upload SVGs using entity-encoded or CDATA-wrapped markup or attribute quote breakouts to execute JavaScript in the Penpot origin when victims open them.

title: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 2FA Bypass via Race Condition in /api/2fa/verify
desc: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

title: Casdoor before 4.27.1 Denial of Service via SAML Message Decompression
desc: Casdoor before 4.27.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in decodeSamlMessage that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending unbounded DEFLATE-compressed SAML messages. Attackers can send a small, highly compressed SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse to the /api/saml/logout/:owner/:application endpoint, which inflates to gigabytes and crashes or stalls the serv

title: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 Information Disclosure via Public Help Center Article Endpoints
desc: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

title: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b Credential Exposure via javdb Domain Validation Bypass
desc: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie. Attackers can pass an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and set the domain query to a host they control, causing processItems to send the _jdb_session cookie there.

title: Langfuse before 4.82.0 SSRF via GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl
desc: Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.

title: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 Prototype Pollution via Dashboard Chart custom_options
desc: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user, including administrators, views a dashboard rendering the chart, Object.assign merges attacker properties into Object.prototype, altering Frappe desk client behavior fo

title: Weblate before 2026.11 Account Takeover via Unicode E-mail Matching in Password Reset
desc: Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

title: HumHub before 1.19.4 Missing Authorization via Admin Group Member Search Actions
desc: HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Out-of-Bounds Read via Collada ReadFloat
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Out-of-Bounds Read via glTF 1.0 Accessor Counts
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Uninitialized Resource Use via glTF 1.0 Strip/Fan Faces
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Uncontrolled Memory Allocation via FBX Rotation Keyframe Interpolation
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.

title: Resteasy-core: resteasy sourceprovider remote unauthenticated file read
desc: A flaw was found in RESTEasy's SourceProvider. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform an unauthenticated remote file read. By sending a specially crafted XML body with a DOCTYPE declaration referencing external entities to an endpoint that accepts application/xml and returns Source or StreamSource, the server can be tricked into resolving the entity and including sensitiv

title: Openjdk-orb: incomplete fix for cve-2026-15560,unauthed class loading via iiop in eap
desc: when EAP runs with -secmgr, the openjdk-orb's JDKBridge honours attacker-supplied CDR codebase URLs during object unmarshalling on :3528, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to load and instantiate arbitrary classes from a remote URL in the server JVM before EJB security interceptors run.

desc: A flaw was found in the ContentRepositoryImpl.copyExplodedContent function of the wildfly-core library, which is used by WildFly and JBoss EAP to manage server deployments. The issue occurs when the library processes an unsanitized deployment name. Due to a missing containment check, an attacker with the Deployer RBAC role can use path traversal sequences to access files outside the restricted dep

title: Resteasy-core: resteasy: iioimageprovider unbounded image decode (decompression-bomb dos)
desc: A flaw was found in RESTEasy's IIOImageProvider, which decodes attacker-supplied image request bodies without enforcing any limit on the declared image dimensions or pixel count. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send a small crafted image declaring enormous dimensions to trigger a very large memory allocation, exhausting the JVM heap and resulting in a denial of service.

title: Io.netty/netty-codec-http: netty: denial of service via unbounded concurrent spdy streams
desc: A flaw was found in Netty. SpdySessionHandler accepts an unlimited number of concurrent remote-initiated streams because localConcurrentStreams defaults to Integer.MAX_VALUE and the handler provides no API to change it. A remote peer can open a SPDY connection and send a large number of SYN_STREAM frames with FLAG_FIN=0, causing unbounded heap and direct memory allocation that can lead to JVM OutO

title: Io.netty/netty-codec-http: netty: denial of service via unbounded httpservercodec http/1.1 pipeline queue
desc: A flaw was found in Netty's HttpServerCodec. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by pipelining HTTP/1.1 requests on a single connection and withholding reads. This action causes the methodOverflowQueue to grow without limit, leading to unbounded heap memory consumption and a denial of service due to memory exhaustion.

title: Io.netty/netty-codec-http: netty: unbounded per-connection queue growth in websocketserverextensionhandler leads to denial of service
desc: A flaw was found in Netty's WebSocketServerExtensionHandler. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by using HTTP/1.1 pipelining to send requests faster than the application can respond. This leads to an unbounded growth of a per-connection queue, consuming excessive memory. Eventually, this can cause the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) to exhaust its heap, resulting in a Den

title: Io.netty/netty-codec-http: netty: incomplete validation of malformed transfer-encoding allows http request smuggling
desc: A flaw was found in Netty's HTTP/1 decoder. Incomplete validation of malformed Transfer-Encoding headers allows a remote attacker to perform HTTP request smuggling. title: Io.netty/netty-codec-http: netty rtspdecoder method-token smuggling via trailing control byte
